metadata.method_name: SAM vs SGD at matched training loss (Fashion-MNIST small CNN)
metadata.description: Paired seeds 0-4. Primary test: SAM 40 epochs vs SGD with E* epochs (matched eval-mode train loss). Secondary: SAM epoch 40 vs SGD 40-epoch snapshot at the matched epoch. Every model temperature-scaled on validation logits.

predict_fields.predict_sgd_matched_epoch: SGD 40-epoch run at matched epoch e_s (comparison a)
predict_fields.predict_sgd_matched_loss: SGD, E* epochs, final (condition 3, primary comparison)

tuning.selection_rule: lowest final-epoch validation NLL (raw); test not used

pilot.rule: smallest E whose final eval-mode training loss is within tolerance of L_SAM40

reproduction_check.note: Tuned rho=0.1 on seed 101. The earlier run's rho is not recorded in this run's inputs, so this comparison is not exact.

assumptions: No data augmentation (not specified in the plan).
Convolutions have no bias (followed by BatchNorm).
BatchNorm running statistics update in both SAM passes (spec); eval-mode logits at rho=0 therefore differ from SGD.
Metrics use float32 logits; saved logits are float16 for audit.
ACE: Nixon et al. multiclass form, 15 equal-mass bins per class, mean over classes and bins.
Brier: multiclass sum over classes, averaged over samples, raw probabilities.

datasets.dataset: Fashion-MNIST official 10k test set, 5 paired seeds
